Rules / Tool

SK9023 The requested paths hold nothing to analyse

Nothing under the requested paths can be analysed. Under --load=loose it means no .cs file was found under them, reported at info, and the run exits 4 with nothing loaded. Under a project load it means none of the paths named on the command line is part of any loaded project — a typo, a path outside every project, a directory of generated sources — and check refuses with exit 3 rather than report a clean tree. Name the owning project with --project, or use --load=loose.

Since0.6

Why

An unmatched path is the same false clean as an unmatched --rules filter (#278, #346): a filter that selects nothing produces zero findings and a zero exit, and the reader takes it as a verdict on the code. Refusing costs one re-run; a clean report over nothing costs whatever the run was supposed to catch.

When it does not fire

The loose form names the repository root rather than the path it was given. The CLI now rejects a path that does not exist before the loader runs, and rejects an option-like token after check instead of swallowing it as a path — skala check --load loose --verbose used to report this id over a repository full of C#. A directory excluded by skala.jsonc legitimately answers it.
